rules.label: Financially Indigent
rules.quote: Patients may only be granted classification as Financially Indigent if their yearly income as set forth on the Financial Assistance Application is less than or equal to 250% of the poverty guidelines updated annually in the Federal Register by the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services.

rules.label: Medically Indigent (Initial Assessment)
rules.quote: To be considered for classification as a Medically Indigent patient, the amount owed by the patient after payment by all third-party payers must exceed ten percent (10%) of the patient’s income and the patient must be unable to pay the remaining bill.

rules.label: Medically Indigent (Acceptance i)
rules.quote: The patient’s income must be equal to or less than 500% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines.

rules.label: Medically Indigent (Acceptance ii)
rules.quote: The patient’s remaining bill must be greater than 50% of the patient’s income, and the patient’s income must be greater than 500% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines.

notes: Applications remain on file for 365 days.
Expired patients may be deemed to have no income for purposes of income calculation.
If a patient qualifies for other charity programs such as CICP or the Hospital Discount Care Program, this application will not be considered for additional discounts or balance adjustments.
The policy does not specify timing for application submission, ECA restrictions, or first statement issuance relative to service date.
The policy does not establish payment plan terms such as maximum percentage of monthly income, maximum months, or minimum monthly payment.
